C_construction.rule: Ordinary transformer at B's width/depth. Increase feedforward width by round(2*alphabet*dim/3) to account for the two categorical projection matrices per block. Require parameter difference <=0.1%; do not pass softmax probabilities or retain a narrow adapter. Same seed/data, but differing FF shapes prevent identical full initialization.

inherited_A.reason: Identical baseline architecture/data/optimizer/dropout/capacity stopping; scalar arithmetic optimizer/RNG parity tested.

notes: The same ten new A trajectories are shared across families, not twenty independent runs.
Missing threshold crossings stay undefined; speed medians include all ten seeds with censoring.
Categorical B uses deterministic argmax with normalized-softmax STE; no sampled training.
All arithmetic speeds are optimizer updates, ten per epoch; wall time is descriptive on shared GPUs.
Capacity matching and finite-budget delay estimates are not intrinsic capacity bounds or a theorem.
